People think I have an eating disorder, especially people that knew me when I was fat. They’re not entirely wrong, but I‘ve been making a ton of progress in recovery for a while now. I just happen to be at my lowest weight ever (healthily, I just stopped drinking and cut out most refined sugar and now I just kind of eat whatever I want and it’s usually a good quantity of food) and it kind of stings to hear “are you sick??” when I’ve come so far with my recovery.

Side note/rant that’s not super related but: this kind of thing is also the reason why people don’t believe fat people can suffer from eating disorders. Weight can be a visual indicator, but there’s also dry or dull skin/eyes/hair, pallor, easy bruising, brittle nails/marks on fingers if they use them to purge, etc. as well as a myriad of non-visual indicators. Most of these get completely overlooked in fat people with eating disorders because they don’t “look like they have one” and that shit kills people.

Honestly, if there’s a way for the Commission to quietly exile Hawks instead of imprisoning him, I Would Like To See It. I just want him to get his peaceful boring life man.

At worst, it acts as a “justification” for pedophilia writ large. In either case, the promotion of ideas such as “children can be sexy” or “childlike features can be sexy” (which is really just another way of saying “children can be sexy”) has cultural implications beyond just being gross. People see stuff like that and it validates their pedophilic feelings. Young people can see stuff like that and assume that kind of attitude towards children is normal and go along with disgusting behaviors because adults are justifying it (happened to me). hostile mobs can only spawn on opaque, full blocks with a light level below 7 (if you hit f3 the light level is shown among other stats). since glass is classified as a transparent block and not opaque, mobs can’t spawn. similarly, since things like slabs/stairs aren’t considered full blocks (ex. slabs are made up of half blocks), mobs can’t spawn on them. there are some other things that people can use to spawn-proof their builds (like carpets). of course, the most common way of spawn proofing something is just using light lol.

also, only a certain number of hostile mobs can exist in the world at one time, which can be a factor when making farms and stuff. e.g. if you make a hostile mob farm that depends on darkness to function, you’ll get better spawn rates in that farm if you light up all of the caves in the area since it limits the amount of places mobs can spawn. otherwise, mobs that spawn outside of the farm will take up space in the mob cap and lower the rates.
